_doc_emerald: Emerald's overlay of data/hoenn_world.json (emerald_world 2026-10-12): deep-merged over it by version.load_json in HOENN_VERSION=emerald world builds (b2tools/world.py load); Sapphire and Ruby never read it. alt_layouts: pokeemerald's names of the same other layouts (Route 131's Sky Pillar islet = Sapphire's layout 320 with Emerald's 23 changed blocks of Route 131, none inside the islet's retile box; Route 130's Mirage Island = Sapphire's layout 46, block for block); Route 103's Altering Cave layout is Emerald's own (data/emerald/hoenn_map_additions.json). JaggedPass (emerald_integrate 2026-10-12): the Magma Hideout mouth, event 1, on the warp-only map's own matrix (world.py group_alts).

Route111._doc: Emerald's Mirage Tower (emerald_ch9_mirage 2026-10-12): Route 111's own layout has the tower (3x6 blocks at (18-20, 53-58), door (19,58)), pokeemerald's Route111_OnTransition swaps in LAYOUT_ROUTE111_NO_MIRAGE_TOWER when the tower is not shown (half the visits, never after its collapse). Black 2's map replace event 0 (work 0x4031 == 0x1220, condition 3: no Black 2 script of a Hoenn zone sets it; its own entries patch only matrix 0, the Unova overworld) is set while the tower is GONE; src/field_scripts/scenes/emerald/Route111_Mirage.inc decides at the zone init. heights_box: only the tower's tiles may change height.

JaggedPass._doc: Emerald's Magma Hideout mouth (emerald_integrate 2026-10-12): Jagged Pass is a warp-only map (data/hoenn_standalone.json group JaggedPass), so b2tools/world.py group_alts builds the cells that differ in its group and patches/hoenn_world.py swaps their chunks on the group's own matrix while map replace event 1 is set (work 0x4032 == 0x224; Black 2 sets uid 1 from no script and no code, and its own four uid-1 entries, which would load Unova rooms over matrices 342/343/347/350 = HoennB2's Glass Workshop, Fossil Maniac's house, Day Care and Weather Institute 2F, are dropped in a build that uses it). Only the two mouth tiles may change height (heights_box). The default layout is the sealed one (data/emerald/hoenn_map_additions.json LAYOUT_JAGGED_PASS); src/field_scripts/scenes/JaggedPass.inc sets the event at VAR_JAGGED_PASS_STATE 2.

SootopolisCity._doc: Emerald's legends' battle (emerald_ch10 2026-10-12): pokeemerald's SootopolisCity_OnTransition sets LAYOUT_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY_LEGENDS_BATTLE (the lake as rough water, MB_OCEAN_WATER: drawn as sea where the calm lake is a pond; labels data/labels/emerald/gTileset_Sootopolis.json) while Groudon and Kyogre are in the city. Map replace event 1 (shared: Jagged Pass's mouth on its own matrix, the Sky Pillar top below): src/field_scripts/scenes/emerald/SootopolisCity.inc sets it on every entry (VAR_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY_STATE 1-4, or 5 before Rayquaza's scene). Only the lake box may change height.

SkyPillar_Top._doc: Emerald's Sky Pillar top before Rayquaza's Sootopolis scene (emerald_ch10 2026-10-12): pokeemerald's SkyPillar_Top_OnTransition sets LAYOUT_SKY_PILLAR_TOP_CLEAN while VAR_SKY_PILLAR_STATE < 2 (no cracks, other rubble). A warp-only map (world.py group_alts). Map replace event 1, shared with Sootopolis' legends layout (both are the crisis: set together, so the climb from a crisis Sootopolis needs no reload) and Jagged Pass's mouth (its own matrix); scenes/SkyPillar_Top.inc sets it on every entry.
